decision.text: A: xs is not ahead of rsync on a local copy: look for what holds it back (workers, flushing) and still check re-syncs (real-psample neo→neo-ssd xs 0.89× [0.81, 0.99])
B: no worker count beats the default four on this Pi and drive
C: eager writeback or --no-atomic gets the backup onto the drive sooner: confirm it (real-psample neo→neo-ssd xs-eager 1.62× [1.47, 1.78])
D: xs re-syncs the local backup at least as fast as rsync

Cc.why: after C: eager writeback or --no-atomic gets the backup onto the drive sooner: confirm it
